candidates.description: This feature vector represents French modal and auxiliary verbs used to express necessity, possibility, or state of being.
This vector activates for words and suffixes related to abstract ideas, perceptions, and cognitive concepts.
This vector represents human belief systems, cultural practices, and societal structures.
These tokens represent Roman numerals used in numbers, names, or outlines.
This feature vector activates strongly on tokens starting with the prefix "int-" or closely related variants.
This vector activates on concepts related to difference, variety, and difficulty.
This vector represents internal mental states, cognitive focus, and emotional or psychological attributes.
This vector represents religious or ideological dogmas, orthodoxies, and formalized belief systems.
This vector activates on tokens containing the suffix or letter sequence "-ent-" or related word endings.
This feature vector represents the letter "k" and its variations in various phonetic contexts and capitalization.
